utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Oren: I’m going to check the tools and screws first, then I’ll let you know what to set aside. Thanks, Pia — and if I spot anything missing, I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll see you Sunday at 2 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, see you then—thanks again for pitching in!

utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is really picking up — what still needs doing?

utterances.text: Jules: We’re in good shape, just a few last things to match up and some tools to sort. If you can help check donations, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I can help check the donations and sort the tools. I’ll keep an eye out for any furniture or bike repairs we still need to match up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’re welcome, Uli — glad Sunday at the community center works for you. I’ll spread the word in the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure they know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Rosa — I’ve got it down for Sunday at the community center, and I’m happy to help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that means a lot. I’ll let you know right away if any repair details change.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll get started on the faucet and let you know once it’s done.

utterances.text: Mina: So what’s the first thing you still need for the repair drive?
